description: Header file defining ARM NEON intrinsic functions and macros for non-temporal memory operations, specific to ARM64 architecture.

methods.name: _mm_sfence
methods.description: Ensures memory store ordering on ARM64 architecture.

methods.name: _mm_lddqu_si128
methods.description: Alias for unaligned load of 128-bit data.

methods.name: _mm_loadu_si128
methods.description: Loads 128-bit integer data from unaligned memory.

methods.name: _mm_stream_si128
methods.description: Stores 128-bit data to memory without polluting caches.

methods.name: _mm_set_epi8
methods.description: Sets 16 signed 8-bit integer values into a 128-bit register.
